e: Consolidated CBET solicitation; EBBS funds engineering of platforms, devices and processes that probe or control biological function (the former biophotonics and biosensing areas fall here), and TP/CPS/EWRE cover transport, process and energy engineering. No limits on proposals per PI; no citizenship restriction.
n: NSF ENG CBET (NSF 26-518): Engineering Biological & Biomedical Systems (EBBS), Transport Phenomena, Chemical Process Systems, Energy/Water/Resources
unv: Whether biophotonics is named explicitly in EBBS scope was not checked.
